channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: Spitfire Homes to tackle industry's skills shortage with new pledge
item.description: Spitfire Homes has committed to tackling the industry's workforce shortfall by pledging a new minimum requirement of 5 per cent of its total workforce to be made up of trainees or graduates.

item.title: Yorkshire and the Humber falls down UK rankings in PwC's Women in Work Index - "meaningful progress on pay equality, but deteriorating performance across most other measures"
item.description: Yorkshire and the Humber has fallen down the UK rankings of PwC's Women in Work Index 2026, with progress on pay equality but a deteriorating performance in most other areas.

item.title: Civil engineering specialist Wrekin with "real sense of momentum" after year of growth
item.description: Civil engineering product manufacturer Wrekin has a "real sense of momentum" following an increase in turnover last year despite an "overall market decline".

item.title: North West records significant improvement in PwC's Women in Work Index - "It’s progress that matters for women and for the regional economy"
item.description: The North West has recorded one of the strongest improvements in the UK for gender equality, according to PwC's Women in Work Index 2026.

item.title: Plans to help Cardiff Draconians FC secure new funding to be agreed
item.description: Plans aimed at helping local football club Cardiff Draconians secure additional funding to improve facilities at their home in Lydstep Park are set to be agreed with the council.

item.title: Econ Engineering supplies gritters to maintenance contractor - "we've genuinely loved working with Marlborough Highways to bring these striking red vehicles to life"
item.description: Econ Engineering has supplied a fleet of gritters to Marlborough Highways.

item.title: Flagship scheme of 475 homes in Hinckley to get underway
item.description: Vistry is due to start work on a flagship development of 475 homes in Hinckley, Leicestershire.

item.title: Historic former bank building in Warwick changes hands
item.description: Commercial property agency Bromwich Hardy has sold a historic former bank building in Warwick to a corporate investor.

item.title: Member support specialist wins national arts access contract
item.description: An inclusive member support specialist has been awarded a national contract to provide services for an arts access scheme for disabled people.

item.title: Major training provider acquired by PE-backed group - deal supported by BTG
item.description: A UK training provider which has supported more than 300,000 professionals across 60-plus countries has been acquired by a private equity-backed group in a deal supported by BTG.
